item.tib: byams ma yang gsang rgyun mchod man ngag 'jigs pa kun sel gyi tshogs bsags maN+Dal cho ga'i cha lag gter gyi bong mdzod
item.coloph: de ltar gyi brtson pa bdag 'drar sngon sbyang gi dmigs bus ma zin shing / thos bsam gyi sgyid pa ma rang ste shes bya'i 'khar ba bral ba'i dpyod ldan pa'i rjes su snyegs pa/ bye ma slebs (phye ma leb) kyis mkha' lding gi rjes su bdas pa lta bu las ma mchis shing bzhad gad (bgad) kyi rten las ci zhig ste/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bstan 'dzin tshul khrims grags pas bka' yi zhal chem phebs pa spyi bor mchod cing / 'gran bral grub pa'i dbang phyug bla khri rgyal ba g.yung drung gis zhal gyi bdud rtsi tshar du dngar ba'i gnang skyes dang / lhag par stag sprul spungs wer shel bzhin gyis gzhan sde chos lugs sogs la maN+Dal bzhi chog mchis mod rang sgo la'ang 'di lta bu dgos pa'i nan tan du gsung gi dbyug gis brdung ba la/ yid kyi rnga chung gis rang sgra mi grags ka med du byung ba dang / ma tshad mgron gnyer lha rgyal bkra shis/ nye gnas g.yung drung rgyal mtshan sogs kyis sbub sil dus mnyam pas bskul bar brten pa 'dis 'gal ba bshags shing dge tshogs bsngo ba'i gtan tshigs dang bcas te rab myos zhes pa lcags rta 'bras ldan zla tshes bzang por/ rigs bzhi'i nang tshan rin chen rigs kyi gnas/ bam brag brtsegs pa rin chen 'bar ba'i mthil/ mtsho steng bde ldan g.yung drung gsang sngags khrod du shes rab 'jigs med g.yung drung don ldan gyis bsgrigs te yi ge pa ni drin chen dam pa'i zhal (zhabs) rdul spyir bor phog pa'i drung yig phrin las lhun grub dpal bzang bdag gis gter chen dam pa'i zhal snga nas phebs 'phral rab dga' g.yung drung sems dpa'i mthong lam gyi dga' ba thob pa lta bu'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas bskrun pa'o//
